description: Grafana v2 example for vault-solver metrics. Uses example scrape labels namespace and pod; adapt selectors, grouping and table fields to your collection setup. Choose a Prometheus-compatible datasource. Counters cover the selected interval; current state uses current samples. Missing data is not a healthy state.

spec.title: Advertised input ceiling by pair
spec.description: Maximum active input per pair; alternative curves are maxed, not summed. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: label_replace((label_replace(((max by (namespace, pod, token_in, token_out, token_in_decimals, token_out_decimals) (lifi_active_quote_max_input_atomic_units{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})) > 0), "token_in_display", "​$1", "token_in", "(.*)")), "token_out_display", "​$1", "token_out", "(.*)")

spec.title: Published quote state
spec.description: Current standing quote and range population over time. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Quote/recovery operation p95
spec.description: Publication, suspension, and recovery latency trends. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, pod, le, operation) (rate(solver_bot_external_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="lifi-samechain"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Processing and queue-drop totals
spec.description: Submitted/deferred/dropped decisions plus bounded queue-full drops. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: (sum by (namespace, pod, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="lifi-samechain",event="order_processing"}[$__range])) or label_replace(sum by (namespace, pod, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="lifi-samechain",event="queue_drop"}[$__range])), "outcome", "queue_drop:$1", "outcome", "(.*)")) > 0

spec.title: Queued backlog
spec.description: Backlog growth and failure to drain by retry stage. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Nearest queued deadline
spec.description: Remaining protocol time for each non-empty queue stage. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod, stage) ((clamp_min((lifi_order_nearest_deadline_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}) - time(), 0) * ((lifi_order_nearest_deadline_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}) > bool time())) > 0)

spec.title: Fill transaction outcomes
spec.description: Exact terminal txmanager outcomes over the selected range. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Successful fill amounts
spec.description: Receipt-confirmed token amounts; planned surplus is not realized PnL. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Execution cost
spec.description: Receipt-backed transaction count, gas, and native fee over the selected range. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Feed and recovery history
spec.description: Connection continuity and convergent-recovery readiness. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Pod details
spec.description: Per-pod values. Counters cover the selected interval; readiness and gauges use current samples. Retired pods have no current state.

title: Vault Solver · LI.FI

spec.name: pods
spec.label: Pods
spec.description: All expands to the pod names discovered for this solver and selected time range.
